trapDetection.title: Trap Detection (passive Perception)
trapDetection.hint: Draw a Region at a trap's true location, add the 'Trap Detection' behavior to set its DC and detection range, and get a private message whenever a PC's token comes within range - passive Perception vs the DC decides if they notice it. Notifies once per PC per trap.
trapDetection.spotted: {name} notices something suspicious nearby (passive Perception meets/beats DC {dc}).
trapDetection.notSpotted: {name} passes near a hidden trap without noticing it (DC {dc}).

lockpicking.title: Lockpicking
lockpicking.hint: Clicking a locked door as GM offers to attempt picking it with the currently controlled/selected PC's Thieves' Tools instead of the default silent 'locked' behavior. The lock's DC is set once per door and remembered.
lockpicking.noActor: No controlled/selected token to attempt the lockpick with.
lockpicking.setDcHint: This door's lock difficulty hasn't been set yet. Set it once - it will be remembered for future attempts.
lockpicking.success: {name} picks the lock successfully. The door is now unlocked.

screenAlert.name: On-screen alert as well as chat
screenAlert.hint: When a PC notices something, also pop a brief notification on the owning player's screen. The whisper in chat is sent either way - this only adds a nudge, since a chat line is easy to miss mid-scene.

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: The passive Perception a PC needs to meet or beat to notice this trap.

range.label: Detection Range
range.hint: Distance (in scene units) from this Region's footprint within which a nearby PC triggers the check.

skill.label: Passive Skill
skill.hint: Which passive the PC is checked on. Perception for something noticed in passing, Investigation for something that has to be pieced together.

message.label: Message on Success
message.hint: What the player is told when their PC notices this, e.g. 'One flagstone sits a finger lower than the others'. Leave empty for the generic line. Never shown on a failure.

requiresSight.label: Requires Line of Sight
requiresSight.hint: If set, a wall between the PC and this spot prevents detection. Turn off for something noticed by sound or smell around a corner.
